summary: Greenfield `gh plate bootstrap --apply` seeds minimal CURRENT.md from the import-payload #618 template in the grouped payload commit when remote CURRENT.md is absent, so `scripts/validate_plate_repo.sh` passes on a fresh repo (#1322).
migration_impact: New greenfield bootstraps after this change include CURRENT.md on the default branch without a separate import-payload step. Existing repos with CURRENT.md are unchanged (bootstrap skips the path).
agent_notes: Seed Epic milestone attachment for label-check was already handled by `_resolve_bootstrap_epic_milestone_number` and create-initial-epic apply logic; this fragment covers the missing CURRENT.md half of #1322.
